**Which app?** Screenshots to PDF / Local Transcriber / Setup

**What happened, and what did you expect?**

**Steps to reproduce** (a public example video link helps):

**Your PC:** Windows version, NVIDIA GPU (yes/no, model), app version from `READ-ME.txt`

**Log excerpt:** the relevant lines from `setup.log` or `settings\<app>\app-worker.log`.

> ⚠️ Logs can contain your Windows user name, folder paths, video titles and URLs. Replace anything private with `...` before posting. Never post cookies, passwords or tokens.
